title: Shared definitions for the cloud contracts
description: Identifier, date and language formats used by every cloud contract. Identifiers never contain '#', which separates the parts of DynamoDB keys.

pageId.description: Stable page ID, independent of the URL. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

pagePath.description: The page's public path. Page URLs carry no category (Technical Design, Taxonomy).

categorySlug.description: Category or sub-category slug; sub-categories use '/', for example 'economy/inflation'.

entityId.description: Knowledge-graph entity ID, for example 'company:apple' or 'country:IN'.

dataId.description: ID of a data point, figure or chart inside a page's data.json.

chartId.description: ID of a chart; its tabular data is charts/<id>.csv and charts/<id>.json in the bundle.

lang.description: Language of the record (BCP 47, language and optional region). Every cloud record carries it.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 with a 'Z' suffix.

indexStatus.description: Whether the page is offered to search engines (Technical Design, Indexing control).
